financials_interim.notes: BANK (standalone) basis. Licensed commercial bank -- mapped per project's bank convention: revenue = 'Total operating income' (net interest income + net fee income + trading/other operating income), the standard analyst proxy for a bank's top line (no COGS/gross-profit concept, so cost_of_sales/gross_profit left blank). operating_profit = 'Profit before Value Added Tax (VAT) & Social Security Contribution Levy (SSCL) on financial services' as labelled by the filing (Results from operating activities + share of profit of equity-accounted investees). finance_costs/finance_income left blank -- interest expense is already netted into revenue via net interest income, so a separate finance-cost figure would double count. current_assets/current_liabilities/inventory/trade_receivables/trade_payables left blank -- no current/non-current split in a bank balance sheet and the loan book is not a trade receivable. short_term_borrowings = 'Due to banks' (interbank borrowings); long_term_borrowings = 'due to debt security holders' (LKR 3,118Mn of 2026/2031 5-year debentures issued this period) [Group additionally includes 'other borrowed funds' LKR 1,916Mn, presumed term borrowings from DFIs, added to long_term_borrowings]. Customer deposits (due to customers, LKR 130,219Mn Bank / 138,515Mn Group) explicitly excluded from borrowings per project convention. capex = purchase of property & equipment + purchase of intangible assets. Balance-sheet identity (assets = liabilities + equity) and EPS cross-check (PAT / shares in issue) both tie out exactly for Bank and Group -- no column-swap issues found in this filing. Balance sheet comparative in the filing is only vs 31 Dec 2025 (audited FYE), not vs 30 June 2025, so no 30-June-2025 balance-sheet figures exist to store; only the current period (30 June 2026) is entered here, consistent with the project's financial_statements convention of one row per period.

GROUP basis (Bank + subsidiaries UB Finance PLC and National Asset Management Ltd). Licensed commercial bank -- mapped per project's bank convention: revenue = 'Total operating income' (net interest income + net fee income + trading/other operating income), the standard analyst proxy for a bank's top line (no COGS/gross-profit concept, so cost_of_sales/gross_profit left blank). operating_profit = 'Profit before Value Added Tax (VAT) & Social Security Contribution Levy (SSCL) on financial services' as labelled by the filing (Results from operating activities + share of profit of equity-accounted investees). finance_costs/finance_income left blank -- interest expense is already netted into revenue via net interest income, so a separate finance-cost figure would double count. current_assets/current_liabilities/inventory/trade_receivables/trade_payables left blank -- no current/non-current split in a bank balance sheet and the loan book is not a trade receivable. short_term_borrowings = 'Due to banks' (interbank borrowings); long_term_borrowings = 'due to debt security holders' (LKR 3,118Mn of 2026/2031 5-year debentures issued this period) [Group additionally includes 'other borrowed funds' LKR 1,916Mn, presumed term borrowings from DFIs, added to long_term_borrowings]. Customer deposits (due to customers, LKR 130,219Mn Bank / 138,515Mn Group) explicitly excluded from borrowings per project convention. capex = purchase of property & equipment + purchase of intangible assets. Balance-sheet identity (assets = liabilities + equity) and EPS cross-check (PAT / shares in issue) both tie out exactly for Bank and Group -- no column-swap issues found in this filing. Balance sheet comparative in the filing is only vs 31 Dec 2025 (audited FYE), not vs 30 June 2025, so no 30-June-2025 balance-sheet figures exist to store; only the current period (30 June 2026) is entered here, consistent with the project's financial_statements convention of one row per period.

interim_updates.note_text: Union Bank of Colombo PLC's Bank-level PBT rose 84% YoY to LKR 881Mn for 1H2026 (1H2025: LKR 478Mn) and PAT rose 134% to LKR 587Mn (1H2025: LKR 251Mn), on net interest income up 22% to LKR 3,148Mn (interest income +24% to LKR 8,776Mn against interest expense +24% to LKR 5,629Mn) and net fee & commission income up 13% to LKR 732Mn. Total operating income jumped 58% to LKR 1,250Mn, but LKR 249Mn of that -- roughly a fifth -- was a one-off gain on the Bank's sale of shares in subsidiary UB Finance PLC, booked within 'Net other operating income' (which rose 199% to LKR 350Mn); stripping that out, underlying operating income growth was closer to 36%. Impairment charges swung negative, from a LKR 24Mn net charge in 1H2025 to a LKR 266Mn net charge in 1H2026 (NM), consistent with 16% YoY growth in gross loans and advances to LKR 136,742Mn per the Bank's own press release. At Group level (Bank + UB Finance PLC + National Asset Management Ltd), PBT rose 97% to LKR 997Mn and PAT rose 141% to LKR 604Mn, outpacing the Bank alone, indicating the non-bank subsidiaries (leasing/finance and asset management) contributed disproportionately to the improvement -- Group PBT excluding the Bank's own PBT implies roughly LKR 116Mn of subsidiary-level PBT in 1H2026 versus roughly LKR 28Mn in 1H2025.
interim_updates.gaps_note: No QoQ comparison possible: no quarter closer to this one has been collected for UBC -- this is the first financial_statements entry for this symbol. The filing's own balance sheet comparative is only vs 31 Dec 2025 (audited FYE), not 30 June 2025, so balance-sheet-based YoY (e.g. loan/deposit growth) relies on the company's own press-release figures rather than a directly recomputed comparison.
interim_updates.takeaway: Headline growth is real but partly one-off: about LKR 249Mn of the 58% jump in Bank operating income came from a single share-sale gain in subsidiary UB Finance PLC, and results also carry a much heavier net impairment charge (LKR 266Mn vs LKR 24Mn) as the loan book expanded 16% YoY -- underlying core banking profitability improved but by less than the headline 84%/134% PBT/PAT growth suggests.

operational_highlights: Bank PBT +84% YoY to LKR 881Mn; PAT +134% YoY to LKR 587Mn (1H2026 vs 1H2025)
Net interest income +22% to LKR 3,148Mn on 24% growth in both interest income (LKR 8,776Mn) and interest expense (LKR 5,629Mn)
Net fee & commission income +13% to LKR 732Mn, led by retail, SME and corporate banking per the Bank's own commentary
Total operating income +58% to LKR 1,250Mn, including a LKR 249Mn one-off gain on sale of shares in subsidiary UB Finance PLC
Gross loans and advances +16% YoY to LKR 136,742Mn; customer deposits +10% YoY to LKR 130,219Mn (Bank, per company press release)
Group PBT +97% to LKR 997Mn and Group PAT +141% to LKR 604Mn, both growing faster than the Bank alone
key_drivers: One-off LKR 249Mn gain on sale of UB Finance PLC shares embedded in 'Net other operating income' (+199% to LKR 350Mn) -- inflates the 58% operating income growth figure
Net impairment charge swung to LKR 266Mn (1H2026) from LKR 24Mn (1H2025), a function of 16% loan book growth and CBSL-mandated ECL staging/overlays

Non-bank subsidiaries (UB Finance PLC, National Asset Management Ltd) drove Group PBT/PAT growth (97%/141%) well above Bank-only growth (84%/134%), implying meaningfully improved subsidiary profitability
Bank issued LKR 3,000Mn of new 2026/2031 debentures during the period, lifting Debt to Equity Ratio to 39.7% (from 24.8% at FY2025) and reducing Interest Cover to 4.5x (from 10.7x)
